facts.statement: Sichuanosuchus is an extinct genus of crocodyliform that lived in China during the Late Jurassic and possibly the Early Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Sichuanosuchus is an extinct genus of crocodyliform from the Late Jurassic and possibly Early Cretaceous of China.

facts.statement: The type species S. huidongensis was described in 1995 by Peng Guangzhao based on a nearly complete skeleton found in Jurassic sediments of the Shangshaximiao Formation in the Sichuan Basin.
facts.quote: La especie tipo, S. huidongensis, fue descrita en 1995 por Peng Guangzhao basándose en un esqueleto casi completo descubierto en los sedimentos jurásicos de la Formación Shangshaximiao en la cuenca de Sichuan.

facts.statement: The species S. shuhanensis is later, with its fossils likely dating to the Early Cretaceous.
facts.quote: S. shuhanensis es una especie posterior, siendo que la localidad en la cual se hallaron sus restos probablemente data de principios del Cretácico.

facts.statement: Sichuanosuchus was small, with a skull measuring about 6.1 centimeters in the type species and approximately 6.7 centimeters in S. shuhanensis.
facts.quote: Sichuanosuchus alcanzaba un tamaño reducido - su cráneo medía cerca de 6.1 centímetros de longitud en la especie tipo y aproximadamente 6.7 centímetros en la especie S. shuhanensis

facts.statement: Sichuanosuchus moved on four legs, possessing relatively long and slender forelimbs.
facts.quote: Sichuanosuchus se desplazaba con sus cuatro patas, con miembros delanteros relativamente largos y delgados.

facts.statement: Sichuanosuchus had heterodont dentition with large, serrated, laterally flattened front teeth shaped like canines and lower posterior teeth, indicating it ate meat.
facts.quote: Poseía una dentición heterodonta con grandes delanteros aserrados y aplanados lateralmente, en forma de caninos y dientes posteriores más bajos que muestran que Sichuanosuchus se alimentaba de carne.

facts.statement: Sichuanosuchus likely led a semi-aquatic life.
Dollman et al. (2018) erected the clade Shartegosuchoidea to include Shartegosuchidae, Sichuanosuchus, Zosuchus, and Shantungosuchus.
facts.quote: Dollman et al. (2018) went further by erecting Shartegosuchoidea for the clade formed by Shartegosuchidae, Sichuanosuchus, Zosuchus, and Shantungosuchus.

facts.statement: Fossil evidence places Sichuanosuchus in the Bathonian to Callovian stages, between 168.2 and 161.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Bathonian to Callovian (168.2 to 161.5 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Poll and Norell (2004) classified Sichuanosuchus as the sister taxon to Shantungosuchus and Zosuchus based on a ventrally deflected posterior region of the mandibular rami.
rejected.quote: Poll and Norell (2004) recovered Sichuanosuchus as sister to Shantungosuchus and Zosuchus based on the presence of a ventrally deflected posterior region of the mandibular rami.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'a ventrally deflected posterior region of the mandibular'
